stories.title: Two groups verify mathematician’s claim that Claude helped prove mathematics problem
summary: Anthropic’s Levent Alpöge says it took six weeks for him using the AI tool to solve 19th-century Riemann hypothesisA mathematician at Anthropic has said that the San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) company’s software has helped crack one of the most important unsolved problems in mathematics – and experts say the claim checks out.Levent Alpöge, a Turkish American mathematician, on Friday posted a note on his personal website saying that Claude, the AI software, had helped prove the Riemann hypothesis.

He says that Claude helped develop a solution to the problem during the course of about six weeks.This story was edited on 22 November 2026 to account for updated information: the Lean Focused Research Organization and the Mathlib Initiative statement claiming to verify the solution was added, and a quote from a prior story from a mathematician was removed, as updates to the news evolved Continue reading...
